issues: The Fanfare effect is incomplete: if there's a Risa Matoba on your field, it should both give this follower +1/+1 and grant Storm. Encode the then-effect as a sequence of buff self by 1/1 and grantKeyword storm to self.

Rush and Assail are incorrectly encoded as unconditional keywords. They should be conditional while there are at least 3 Cool followers or a follower with "Risa Matoba" in its name on your field; encode as a passive conditional keyword-grant effect. The current engine lacks a condition for counting followers by one trait OR checking followers whose name contains a substring, so implement support for a field-name-contains condition and/or a conditionAny variant that can combine field follower-count conditions with name-based field checks.

The Fanfare condition is too strict: "if there's a follower on your field with \"Risa Matoba\" in its name" is not the same as requiring an exact card name of Risa Matoba. It should check for a follower whose name contains "Risa Matoba". Implement a condition for named followers on field by substring/contains and use that here.
keywords incorrectly includes fanfare, but the card has no Fanfare ability. Remove the fanfare keyword.

The evolve abilities are encoded incorrectly. The card has two evolve cost lines: a normal [evolve] [cost03]: Evolve this follower, and an alternate [evolve] [cost01]: Evolve this follower that is usable only if Sanguine is active. Encode evolveCost as 3 and add a conditional evolve ability/cost reduction for Sanguine rather than a passiveKeywords effect on timing evolve.

Assail, Bane, and Drain are unconditional printed keywords and should remain as keywords, not be represented by an evolve-timing passiveKeywords ability tied to Sanguine. Remove that incorrect ability.

The Strike effect targets are wrong: the source says "Deal 2 damage to each enemy leader," meaning only enemy leaders are damaged, not all enemies. Replace dealDamageAllEnemies with an effect that deals 2 damage to each enemy leader.
